LanguageData.RT_BT5_Vehicle.label: BT-5
LanguageData.RT_BT5_Vehicle.description:
A light tank said to be good at hunting leopards, equipped with a 45mm gun, has great mobility but poor armor, can upgrade to BT-42 with howitzer.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
45x310mmR（Main Cannon）
7.62x54mmR（Coaxial MG）
